# HubSpot is headless. Here’s how we’ll price it

- Every HubSpot seat comes with enough headless access to complete your everyday work from Claude or ChatGPT, at no additional cost.
- Customers can connect third-party agents to HubSpot’s existing APIs. That usage counts toward the API capacity already included with their plan, and does not consume credits.
- For teams that want to give their third-party agents strong governance, full traceability, and purpose-built tools to deliver better outcomes, that usage runs on HubSpot Credits.

*HubSpot is headless without the headaches.*

Every software platform is facing the same decision right now: what to do when AI agents show up at the door.

Many platforms are restricting AI access to their most expensive tier, selling it as an add-on, or charging for the same work twice. Their message is clear: “Your data lives here, and we’re going to tax you to use it with outside AI.”

At HubSpot, we think your data belongs to you. So does the choice of which AI tools and agents you work with. HubSpot gives you headless without the headaches, and it doesn’t hold your data hostage.

We’ll give broad access to HubSpot from Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools you use with the seats you are already paying for. If you want to bring your own agent to HubSpot, you decide how to connect it: through the same APIs your plan already includes, or through a secure environment that gives agents the tools they need to operate at scale and gives you the control and visibility.

## Your seat works wherever you do

Nobody should have to leave the AI tools they work in to get value from HubSpot.

Through HubSpot’s connectors for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot, plus our MCP server and Agent CLI, a sales rep can summarize open deals, a CSM can prep for a renewal call, and a marketer can launch a campaign without opening another tab. It’s a big part of why HubSpot is the #1 CRM connector in both Claude and ChatGPT.

This everyday connector use isn’t an extra charge. It comes included with a HubSpot seat. For power users who lean on AI tools more than most, HubSpot Credits will give them the flexibility to expand the capacity included with their seat without buying an add-on or additional seat type.

## Bring your own agents. They’re welcome here

If you’ve built or bought an agent, you can connect it to HubSpot with the same APIs that power thousands of integrations today. The API calls that your agents use will count towards the API capacity already included with your plan and will not consume credits.

For everyone already using those APIs to connect their existing tech stack to HubSpot, nothing changes. HubSpot continues to include generous API capacity in our plans. For teams that push the limits of what is already included, additional capacity can be added at any time.

## Agents work differently. They deserve their own experience

Reading and writing to HubSpot’s proven system of record is just the beginning. To deliver real outcomes, an agent needs to understand your business, your teams, and your customer. And you need to trust what that agent is doing, especially when no one is watching.

That’s why HubSpot is building a governed environment designed specifically for agents. They’ll get access to purpose-built agentic APIs that provide deeper business context and the ability to complete work across HubSpot at scale. You’ll get control over what each agent can access and do, a record of every action, and clear visibility into which agent did what. When agents work at scale in this environment, like enriching records and personalizing outreach, that work is paid for with credits.

## Open by default. Flexible by design

AI should make you more capable, not constrained. With HubSpot, your team can take the platform they love to the places they work, all with their existing HubSpot seat. Agents you’ve built or bought plug in like any other integration. When you’re ready to hand an agent more responsibility, HubSpot gives it the context and tools to do the job well and gives you the oversight to trust it.

The industry has spent too long building platforms that force businesses to compromise. We want to keep you in the driver’s seat when making decisions on how your teams work. That’s why we’re building a platform that lets you work wherever you choose and remains widely open to the tools you rely on.

Topics: [HubSpot POV](https://www.hubspot.com/company-news/topic/hubspot-pov) [Headless](https://www.hubspot.com/company-news/topic/headless)
